scoring_rule: answer_correct = for every group in answer_keyword_groups, at least one keyword appears in the normalized answer. For unanswerable cases, answer_correct = at least one refusal_keyword appears and no case-specific fabrication_keyword appears. All matching is case-insensitive after stripping punctuation. The fabrication guard is a lexical heuristic for refusal-plus-invention; it does not replace manual audit of unanswerable cases.
link_construction: WikiPage links_to/links_from are manually verified from source document content, NOT produced by WikiCompiler. WikiCompiler currently leaves links_to empty; this dataset uses hand-built linked pages to evaluate follow_links capability. This is explicitly recorded as a capability gap of the current compiler.

comparability_notes.retrieval_evidence_metrics: COMPARABLE across Baseline and Experiment. Both measure whether required pages were found (evidence_recall, source_precision, multi_hop_success), independent of the answer generator. evidence_recall is the legacy name for access_recall (accessed_pages also includes search candidate lookups). read_evidence_recall uses only pages actually read by the Agent; for the baseline, read_page_ids is its retrieved context set.
comparability_notes.answer_quality_metrics: NOT directly comparable. Baseline uses DeterministicGenerator (offline extractive, copies text from retrieved chunks). Experiment uses a real LLM. Differences in answer_accuracy may come from retrieval, evidence organization, OR the generator itself. Report as independent system results, not a head-to-head comparison.
comparability_notes.scoring_caveat: Answer scoring uses keyword_group_match (lexical heuristic). A semantically correct paraphrase may score 0; a verbatim copy may score 1. This is not an LLM-as-judge evaluation.
comparability_notes.unanswerable_caveat: 7 unanswerable case(s). Keyword-only refusal scoring can accept a refusal followed by a fabricated answer; unanswerable results require manual audit.
comparability_notes.metric_update_phase_08: New verified_* metrics require status=='answered' AND at least one cited source. The legacy answer_accuracy, evidence_support_rate_answerable and multi_hop_success_rate keys keep their original keyword/recall definitions so older result files stay comparable. unsupported_correct exposes keyword-correct answers without a cited, successfully-answered basis.
comparability_notes.source_deduplication: Cited source lists are deduplicated before source_precision is computed. Earlier result files may count the same document twice, so mean_source_precision is not directly comparable across that change.

retrieval_evidence_metrics.note: Comparable across Baseline and Experiment: both measure whether required pages were found, independent of the answer generator.

mean_evidence_recall_answerable.definition: LEGACY: |accessed_pages ∩ required| / |required|. accessed_pages includes search candidate accesses.

mean_access_recall_answerable.definition: |accessed_pages ∩ required| / |required|. accessed_pages records every get/get_by_path lookup, including search candidates; it is not read-only.

mean_read_evidence_recall_answerable.definition: |read_page_ids ∩ required| / |required|. read_page_ids comes from AgentResult.read_page_ids (actual read/follow_links results), not search candidates. Baseline maps read_page_ids to its retrieved context set.

evidence_support_rate_answerable.definition: LEGACY: answer_correct AND evidence_recall==1.0, among answerable cases. Does NOT require cited sources or a successful terminal status; use verified_evidence_support_rate_answerable.

verified_evidence_support_rate_answerabl.definition: grounded_correct AND evidence_recall==1.0, among answerable cases. grounded_correct requires a successful answer status and at least one cited source.

multi_hop_success_rate.definition: LEGACY: answer_correct AND evidence_recall==1.0, among answerable multi-hop cases. See verified_multi_hop_success_rate.

verified_multi_hop_success_rate.definition: grounded_correct AND evidence_recall==1.0, among answerable multi-hop cases.

answer_quality_metrics.note: NOT directly comparable across systems: Baseline uses DeterministicGenerator (offline extractive), Experiment uses a real LLM. Report as independent results.

answer_accuracy.grounding_note: LEGACY metric: keyword_group_match only. It can count an answer with no cited evidence as correct. See verified_answer_accuracy.

verified_answer_accuracy.definition: answer_correct AND status=='answered' AND at least one cited source

unsupported_correct.definition: keyword-correct but NOT grounded: no cited source, or a non-answered terminal status (insufficient_evidence / budget / protocol / model error)
unsupported_correct.interpretation: Candidate false positives from the lexical scorer or answers produced without evidence.

unanswerable_handling.caveat: 7 unanswerable case(s); keyword-only refusal scoring can accept a refusal followed by a fabricated answer. Treat as a manual-audit metric.

answer_quality_metrics.scoring_rule: keyword_group_match (lexical heuristic, NOT semantic correctness; paraphrases may score low even when correct)

efficiency_metrics.failure_rate_definition: cases with a terminal error or status in (model_error, protocol_error); budget_exhausted also carries an error string, so it is included
